title: Provider bootstrap recipes pin activation provenance and wait for the requested provider generation
claim: Every Host Agent local provider bootstrap recipe that overrides opute.provider.install.recipeSource must pass the source, its exact immutable commit revision, and its SHA-256 from required recipe inputs. The Host Agent rejects a remote source whose explicit revision disagrees with the commit in its URL; provider descriptor fallback metadata never replaces the caller's revision. The K3s bootstrap defaults to starting its provider service, allows an explicit restart for a version upgrade, and is successful only when an active, connected generation reports the exact provider version selected by the descriptor.
rationale: A recipe that supplies a pinned raw GitHub URL and digest but omits revision can inherit a descriptor's working-tree revision. The Host Agent correctly rejects that mismatch, but only after earlier bootstrap nodes may have installed a binary and service. Separately, replacing a provider binary does not replace a process already running from the previous version; a status check for active and connected alone can therefore report an old generation as a successful upgrade. The version gate prevents that false green, while the explicit service-state input avoids silently restarting a healthy provider.
owner: wunderous/host-agents owns provider bootstrap recipes, source parsing, and their typed regression evidence.

exception: No remote source may inherit descriptor revision fallback when a recipe overrides recipeSource. K3s bootstrap may not treat an older active generation as success for a newer descriptor version, and it may not silently restart an active provider. Adding another source type requires an explicit typed source, revision, and content-digest contract with matching validation and regression evidence.

required: both bootstrap recipes require a lowercase 40-character activationRecipeRevision input
both nested provider install actions pass source, revision, and SHA-256 from those inputs
resolved plan arguments preserve the three supplied values together
K3s install defaults serviceState to start and accepts only start or restart
K3s install validates active, connected status against the provider version selected by plugin.yaml
the K3s recipe verifier rejects removal or mismatch of that version gate
the Host Agent parser accepts a matching URL revision and rejects a mismatch
the verifier checks file anchors and confirms CI reaches the regression tests

revisionBehavior: Bump a recipe's patch or minor version when its behavior changes without making a new input mandatory; bump its major version when the required input contract changes. Keep the K3s plugin descriptor, install-recipe descriptor, active-version status gate, and provider wire metadata aligned. Recompute and review whole-file anchors when either recipe, source parser, regression test, Makefile verifier wiring, or CI test entry point changes.
